mapper.select: SELECT class_id, class_name, grade, grade_index, class_no, head_teacher, capacity FROM class_info WHERE class_id = #{classId}

WITH totals AS ( SELECT s.id AS student_id, COALESCE(SUM(sc.score), 0) AS total FROM student s LEFT JOIN student_score sc ON sc.student_id = s.id GROUP BY s.id ), att_stat AS ( SELECT a.student_id, SUM(a.status = '出勤') AS present, SUM(a.status = '迟到') AS late, SUM(a.status = '缺勤') AS absent, SUM(a.status = '请假') AS leave_cnt FROM attendance_record a GROUP BY a.student_id ) SELECT c.class_id, COUNT(s.id) AS total_count, COALESCE(SUM(s.status = '在读'), 0) AS active_count, AVG(CASE WHEN s.status = '在读' THEN t.total END) AS avg_total, AVG(CASE WHEN s.status = '在读' THEN (a.present + a.late) / NULLIF(a.present + a.late + a.absent + a.leave_cnt, 0) END) AS avg_rate FROM class_info c LEFT JOIN student s ON s.class_id = c.class_id LEFT JOIN totals t ON t.student_id = s.id LEFT JOIN att_stat a ON a.student_id = s.id
WHERE 1 = 0
WHERE c.class_id IN #{cid}
GROUP BY c.class_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO class_info (class_id, class_name, grade, grade_index, class_no, head_teacher, capacity) VALUES (#{classId}, #{className}, #{grade}, #{gradeIndex}, #{classNo}, #{headTeacher}, #{capacity})
mapper.update: UPDATE class_info SET capacity = #{capacity} WHERE class_id = #{classId}
